question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

Clouds are a kaledoscope of shapes, sizes, patterns and colours.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Kaleidoscope​****."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **'kaledoscope.'**
 
• The correct spelling is "Kaleidoscope​."
 
• "Kaleidoscope​" means a large number of different things. (बड़ी संख्‍या में विभिन्‍न प्रकार की वस्‍तुएँ; वैविध्‍यपूर्ण वस्‍तुओं का संग्रह)
 
 
• Example: *The street bazaar was a **kaleidoscope**__ of colours, smells, and sounds.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Clouds are a __**kaleidoscope**__ of shapes, sizes, patterns and colours.*
